title: Persona vs. Poet — An Easy Way to Differentiate
skills: distinguish a poetic persona from the poet
identify the speaker or persona within a poem
avoid assuming the speaker represents the author's personal beliefs
analyze how persona shapes voice and perspective
alignment_note: Explains the distinction between a poet and the persona or speaker presented within a poem. Supports poetry analysis, point-of-view interpretation, author-speaker distinction, and evidence-based discussion of poetic voice across high school English courses.
